require('strict') local p = {}
--[[==========================================================================]] --[[ Property formatting functions ]] --[[==========================================================================]]
-- If a link has a suitable entry in the global inter-wiki prefix table at [[:m:Interwiki_map]], -- please consider routing through this prefix rather than as external link URL. -- This will ease future maintenance as necessary updates to the link can be centrally carried out there rather than by updating this module. -- The "external link" icon would disappear for such entries.
function p.adbV(id) --P1907's format regex: [a-z][-a-z]+-([1-3]\d|[1-9])\d{0,3} (e.g. barton-sir-edmund-toby-71) return id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-3]%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-9]%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.admiraltyV(id) --P3562's format regex: [A-Q]\d{4}(\.\d+)? (e.g. D1204.1) return id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d$') or id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d%.%d+$') end
function p.awrV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) end
function p.bibsysV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bneV(id) --P950's format regex: (XX|FF|a)\d{4,7}|(bima|bimo|bica|bis[eo]|bivi|Mise|Mimo|Mima)\d{10} (e.g. XX1234567) return id:match( '^[XF][XF]%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^a%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^bi[mcsv][aoei]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^Mi[sm][eoa]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bnfLink(id,label) if not id:match( '^c?b?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz]$' ) then return false end if not id:match( '^cb.+$' ) then --add cb prefix if it has been removed id = 'cb'..id end return '[https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' '..(label or 'France')..'] [https://data.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' (data)]' end
function p.botanistV(id) return mw.ustring.match( id, "^[%u%l%d%. '-]+$" ) --not easily/meaningfully implementable in Lua's regex since "(this)?" is not allowed, better than nothing --id = id:gsub(' +', '%%20') end
function p.bpnV(id) --P651's format regex: \d{6,8} (e.g. 00123456) return id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --original format regex, changed 8/2019 to or id:match( '^0?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --allow 1-2 leading 0s, allowed by the website or id:match( '^0?0?%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.ccgV(id) return id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*%.%d+$' ) end
function p.dbiV(id) local part1, part2; if id:find ('_res', 1, true) then part1, part2 = id:match ('([^_]+)(_res.+)'); -- split at constant '_res'; part 2 nil when no constant '_res' else part1 = id; -- part2 not in target end if part1:find ('[^%-%l]') then -- if <part1> has anything but lowercase letters and hyphens return false; -- invalid so return false else -- here when <part1> has only lowercase letters and hyphens if part1:match ('^%-') or part1:match ('%-$') then -- first and last characters in <part1> must be lowercase letters return false; -- invalid so return false end end if part2 then if not part2:match ('^_res%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return false; -- invalid so return false end end return id end
function p.dblpV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d?%/%d+-?[%d]*[%a]*-?[%d]*$' ) or id:match( '^[%a]+%/[%w]*-?[%d]*$' ) end
function p.gndV(id) return id:match( '^1[012]?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^[47]%d%d%d%d%d%d%-%d$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%-[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^3%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) end
--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end

require('strict') local p = {}
--[[==========================================================================]] --[[ Property formatting functions ]] --[[==========================================================================]]
-- If a link has a suitable entry in the global inter-wiki prefix table at [[:m:Interwiki_map]], -- please consider routing through this prefix rather than as external link URL. -- This will ease future maintenance as necessary updates to the link can be centrally carried out there rather than by updating this module. -- The "external link" icon would disappear for such entries.
function p.adbV(id) --P1907's format regex: [a-z][-a-z]+-([1-3]\d|[1-9])\d{0,3} (e.g. barton-sir-edmund-toby-71) return id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-3]%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-9]%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.admiraltyV(id) --P3562's format regex: [A-Q]\d{4}(\.\d+)? (e.g. D1204.1) return id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d$') or id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d%.%d+$') end
function p.awrV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) end
function p.bibsysV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bneV(id) --P950's format regex: (XX|FF|a)\d{4,7}|(bima|bimo|bica|bis[eo]|bivi|Mise|Mimo|Mima)\d{10} (e.g. XX1234567) return id:match( '^[XF][XF]%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^a%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^bi[mcsv][aoei]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^Mi[sm][eoa]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bnfLink(id,label) if not id:match( '^c?b?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz]$' ) then return false end if not id:match( '^cb.+$' ) then --add cb prefix if it has been removed id = 'cb'..id end return '[https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' '..(label or 'France')..'] [https://data.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' (data)]' end
function p.botanistV(id) return mw.ustring.match( id, "^[%u%l%d%. '-]+$" ) --not easily/meaningfully implementable in Lua's regex since "(this)?" is not allowed, better than nothing --id = id:gsub(' +', '%%20') end
function p.bpnV(id) --P651's format regex: \d{6,8} (e.g. 00123456) return id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --original format regex, changed 8/2019 to or id:match( '^0?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --allow 1-2 leading 0s, allowed by the website or id:match( '^0?0?%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.ccgV(id) return id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*%.%d+$' ) end
function p.dbiV(id) local part1, part2; if id:find ('_res', 1, true) then part1, part2 = id:match ('([^_]+)(_res.+)'); -- split at constant '_res'; part 2 nil when no constant '_res' else part1 = id; -- part2 not in target end if part1:find ('[^%-%l]') then -- if <part1> has anything but lowercase letters and hyphens return false; -- invalid so return false else -- here when <part1> has only lowercase letters and hyphens if part1:match ('^%-') or part1:match ('%-$') then -- first and last characters in <part1> must be lowercase letters return false; -- invalid so return false end end if part2 then if not part2:match ('^_res%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return false; -- invalid so return false end end return id end
function p.dblpV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d?%/%d+-?[%d]*[%a]*-?[%d]*$' ) or id:match( '^[%a]+%/[%w]*-?[%d]*$' ) end
function p.gndV(id) return id:match( '^1[012]?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^[47]%d%d%d%d%d%d%-%d$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%-[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^3%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) end
--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end

require('strict') local p = {}
--[[==========================================================================]] --[[ Property formatting functions ]] --[[==========================================================================]]
-- If a link has a suitable entry in the global inter-wiki prefix table at [[:m:Interwiki_map]], -- please consider routing through this prefix rather than as external link URL. -- This will ease future maintenance as necessary updates to the link can be centrally carried out there rather than by updating this module. -- The "external link" icon would disappear for such entries.
function p.adbV(id) --P1907's format regex: [a-z][-a-z]+-([1-3]\d|[1-9])\d{0,3} (e.g. barton-sir-edmund-toby-71) return id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-3]%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-9]%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.admiraltyV(id) --P3562's format regex: [A-Q]\d{4}(\.\d+)? (e.g. D1204.1) return id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d$') or id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d%.%d+$') end
function p.awrV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) end
function p.bibsysV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bneV(id) --P950's format regex: (XX|FF|a)\d{4,7}|(bima|bimo|bica|bis[eo]|bivi|Mise|Mimo|Mima)\d{10} (e.g. XX1234567) return id:match( '^[XF][XF]%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^a%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^bi[mcsv][aoei]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^Mi[sm][eoa]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bnfLink(id,label) if not id:match( '^c?b?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz]$' ) then return false end if not id:match( '^cb.+$' ) then --add cb prefix if it has been removed id = 'cb'..id end return '[https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' '..(label or 'France')..'] [https://data.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' (data)]' end
function p.botanistV(id) return mw.ustring.match( id, "^[%u%l%d%. '-]+$" ) --not easily/meaningfully implementable in Lua's regex since "(this)?" is not allowed, better than nothing --id = id:gsub(' +', '%%20') end
function p.bpnV(id) --P651's format regex: \d{6,8} (e.g. 00123456) return id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --original format regex, changed 8/2019 to or id:match( '^0?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --allow 1-2 leading 0s, allowed by the website or id:match( '^0?0?%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.ccgV(id) return id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*%.%d+$' ) end
function p.dbiV(id) local part1, part2; if id:find ('_res', 1, true) then part1, part2 = id:match ('([^_]+)(_res.+)'); -- split at constant '_res'; part 2 nil when no constant '_res' else part1 = id; -- part2 not in target end if part1:find ('[^%-%l]') then -- if <part1> has anything but lowercase letters and hyphens return false; -- invalid so return false else -- here when <part1> has only lowercase letters and hyphens if part1:match ('^%-') or part1:match ('%-$') then -- first and last characters in <part1> must be lowercase letters return false; -- invalid so return false end end if part2 then if not part2:match ('^_res%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return false; -- invalid so return false end end return id end
function p.dblpV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d?%/%d+-?[%d]*[%a]*-?[%d]*$' ) or id:match( '^[%a]+%/[%w]*-?[%d]*$' ) end
function p.gndV(id) return id:match( '^1[012]?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^[47]%d%d%d%d%d%d%-%d$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%-[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^3%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) end
--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end

require('strict') local p = {}
--[[==========================================================================]] --[[ Property formatting functions ]] --[[==========================================================================]]
-- If a link has a suitable entry in the global inter-wiki prefix table at [[:m:Interwiki_map]], -- please consider routing through this prefix rather than as external link URL. -- This will ease future maintenance as necessary updates to the link can be centrally carried out there rather than by updating this module. -- The "external link" icon would disappear for such entries.
function p.adbV(id) --P1907's format regex: [a-z][-a-z]+-([1-3]\d|[1-9])\d{0,3} (e.g. barton-sir-edmund-toby-71) return id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-3]%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-9]%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.admiraltyV(id) --P3562's format regex: [A-Q]\d{4}(\.\d+)? (e.g. D1204.1) return id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d$') or id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d%.%d+$') end
function p.awrV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) end
function p.bibsysV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bneV(id) --P950's format regex: (XX|FF|a)\d{4,7}|(bima|bimo|bica|bis[eo]|bivi|Mise|Mimo|Mima)\d{10} (e.g. XX1234567) return id:match( '^[XF][XF]%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^a%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^bi[mcsv][aoei]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^Mi[sm][eoa]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bnfLink(id,label) if not id:match( '^c?b?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz]$' ) then return false end if not id:match( '^cb.+$' ) then --add cb prefix if it has been removed id = 'cb'..id end return '[https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' '..(label or 'France')..'] [https://data.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' (data)]' end
function p.botanistV(id) return mw.ustring.match( id, "^[%u%l%d%. '-]+$" ) --not easily/meaningfully implementable in Lua's regex since "(this)?" is not allowed, better than nothing --id = id:gsub(' +', '%%20') end
function p.bpnV(id) --P651's format regex: \d{6,8} (e.g. 00123456) return id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --original format regex, changed 8/2019 to or id:match( '^0?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --allow 1-2 leading 0s, allowed by the website or id:match( '^0?0?%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.ccgV(id) return id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*%.%d+$' ) end
function p.dbiV(id) local part1, part2; if id:find ('_res', 1, true) then part1, part2 = id:match ('([^_]+)(_res.+)'); -- split at constant '_res'; part 2 nil when no constant '_res' else part1 = id; -- part2 not in target end if part1:find ('[^%-%l]') then -- if <part1> has anything but lowercase letters and hyphens return false; -- invalid so return false else -- here when <part1> has only lowercase letters and hyphens if part1:match ('^%-') or part1:match ('%-$') then -- first and last characters in <part1> must be lowercase letters return false; -- invalid so return false end end if part2 then if not part2:match ('^_res%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return false; -- invalid so return false end end return id end
function p.dblpV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d?%/%d+-?[%d]*[%a]*-?[%d]*$' ) or id:match( '^[%a]+%/[%w]*-?[%d]*$' ) end
function p.gndV(id) return id:match( '^1[012]?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^[47]%d%d%d%d%d%d%-%d$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%-[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^3%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) end
--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end

require('strict') local p = {}
--[[==========================================================================]] --[[ Property formatting functions ]] --[[==========================================================================]]
-- If a link has a suitable entry in the global inter-wiki prefix table at [[:m:Interwiki_map]], -- please consider routing through this prefix rather than as external link URL. -- This will ease future maintenance as necessary updates to the link can be centrally carried out there rather than by updating this module. -- The "external link" icon would disappear for such entries.
function p.adbV(id) --P1907's format regex: [a-z][-a-z]+-([1-3]\d|[1-9])\d{0,3} (e.g. barton-sir-edmund-toby-71) return id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-3]%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-9]%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.admiraltyV(id) --P3562's format regex: [A-Q]\d{4}(\.\d+)? (e.g. D1204.1) return id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d$') or id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d%.%d+$') end
function p.awrV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) end
function p.bibsysV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bneV(id) --P950's format regex: (XX|FF|a)\d{4,7}|(bima|bimo|bica|bis[eo]|bivi|Mise|Mimo|Mima)\d{10} (e.g. XX1234567) return id:match( '^[XF][XF]%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^a%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^bi[mcsv][aoei]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^Mi[sm][eoa]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bnfLink(id,label) if not id:match( '^c?b?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz]$' ) then return false end if not id:match( '^cb.+$' ) then --add cb prefix if it has been removed id = 'cb'..id end return '[https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' '..(label or 'France')..'] [https://data.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' (data)]' end
function p.botanistV(id) return mw.ustring.match( id, "^[%u%l%d%. '-]+$" ) --not easily/meaningfully implementable in Lua's regex since "(this)?" is not allowed, better than nothing --id = id:gsub(' +', '%%20') end
function p.bpnV(id) --P651's format regex: \d{6,8} (e.g. 00123456) return id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --original format regex, changed 8/2019 to or id:match( '^0?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --allow 1-2 leading 0s, allowed by the website or id:match( '^0?0?%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.ccgV(id) return id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*%.%d+$' ) end
function p.dbiV(id) local part1, part2; if id:find ('_res', 1, true) then part1, part2 = id:match ('([^_]+)(_res.+)'); -- split at constant '_res'; part 2 nil when no constant '_res' else part1 = id; -- part2 not in target end if part1:find ('[^%-%l]') then -- if <part1> has anything but lowercase letters and hyphens return false; -- invalid so return false else -- here when <part1> has only lowercase letters and hyphens if part1:match ('^%-') or part1:match ('%-$') then -- first and last characters in <part1> must be lowercase letters return false; -- invalid so return false end end if part2 then if not part2:match ('^_res%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return false; -- invalid so return false end end return id end
function p.dblpV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d?%/%d+-?[%d]*[%a]*-?[%d]*$' ) or id:match( '^[%a]+%/[%w]*-?[%d]*$' ) end
function p.gndV(id) return id:match( '^1[012]?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^[47]%d%d%d%d%d%d%-%d$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%-[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^3%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) end
--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end

require('strict') local p = {}
--[[==========================================================================]] --[[ Property formatting functions ]] --[[==========================================================================]]
-- If a link has a suitable entry in the global inter-wiki prefix table at [[:m:Interwiki_map]], -- please consider routing through this prefix rather than as external link URL. -- This will ease future maintenance as necessary updates to the link can be centrally carried out there rather than by updating this module. -- The "external link" icon would disappear for such entries.
function p.admiraltyV(id) --P3562's format regex: [A-Q]\d{4}(\.\d+)? (e.g. D1204.1) return id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d$') or id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d%.%d+$') end
function p.awrV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) end
function p.bibsysV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bneV(id) --P950's format regex: (XX|FF|a)\d{4,7}|(bima|bimo|bica|bis[eo]|bivi|Mise|Mimo|Mima)\d{10} (e.g. XX1234567) return id:match( '^[XF][XF]%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^a%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^bi[mcsv][aoei]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^Mi[sm][eoa]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bnfLink(id,label) if not id:match( '^c?b?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz]$' ) then return false end if not id:match( '^cb.+$' ) then --add cb prefix if it has been removed id = 'cb'..id end return '[https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' '..(label or 'France')..'] [https://data.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' (data)]' end
function p.botanistV(id) return mw.ustring.match( id, "^[%u%l%d%. '-]+$" ) --not easily/meaningfully implementable in Lua's regex since "(this)?" is not allowed, better than nothing --id = id:gsub(' +', '%%20') end
function p.bpnV(id) --P651's format regex: \d{6,8} (e.g. 00123456) return id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --original format regex, changed 8/2019 to or id:match( '^0?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --allow 1-2 leading 0s, allowed by the website or id:match( '^0?0?%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.ccgV(id) return id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*%.%d+$' ) end
function p.dbiV(id) local part1, part2; if id:find ('_res', 1, true) then part1, part2 = id:match ('([^_]+)(_res.+)'); -- split at constant '_res'; part 2 nil when no constant '_res' else part1 = id; -- part2 not in target end if part1:find ('[^%-%l]') then -- if <part1> has anything but lowercase letters and hyphens return false; -- invalid so return false else -- here when <part1> has only lowercase letters and hyphens if part1:match ('^%-') or part1:match ('%-$') then -- first and last characters in <part1> must be lowercase letters return false; -- invalid so return false end end if part2 then if not part2:match ('^_res%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return false; -- invalid so return false end end return id end
function p.dblpV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d?%/%d+-?[%d]*[%a]*-?[%d]*$' ) or id:match( '^[%a]+%/[%w]*-?[%d]*$' ) end
function p.gndV(id) return id:match( '^1[012]?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^[47]%d%d%d%d%d%d%-%d$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%-[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^3%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) end
--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end

p.sectionOrder = { 'General', -- 1 'National libraries', -- 2 'Art galleries and museums', -- 3 'Art research institutes', -- 4 'Biographical dictionaries', -- 5 'Scientific databases', -- 6 'Lighthouse identifiers', -- 7 'Other' -- 8 } function p.adbV(id) --P1907's format regex: [a-z][-a-z]+-([1-3]\d|[1-9])\d{0,3} (e.g. barton-sir-edmund-toby-71) return id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-3]%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-9]%d?%d?%d?$' ) end return p

require('strict') local p = {}
--[[==========================================================================]] --[[ Property formatting functions ]] --[[==========================================================================]]
-- If a link has a suitable entry in the global inter-wiki prefix table at [[:m:Interwiki_map]], -- please consider routing through this prefix rather than as external link URL. -- This will ease future maintenance as necessary updates to the link can be centrally carried out there rather than by updating this module. -- The "external link" icon would disappear for such entries.
function p.adbV(id) --P1907's format regex: [a-z][-a-z]+-([1-3]\d|[1-9])\d{0,3} (e.g. barton-sir-edmund-toby-71) return id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-3]%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-9]%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.admiraltyV(id) --P3562's format regex: [A-Q]\d{4}(\.\d+)? (e.g. D1204.1) return id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d$') or id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d%.%d+$') end
function p.awrV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) end
function p.bibsysV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bneV(id) --P950's format regex: (XX|FF|a)\d{4,7}|(bima|bimo|bica|bis[eo]|bivi|Mise|Mimo|Mima)\d{10} (e.g. XX1234567) return id:match( '^[XF][XF]%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^a%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^bi[mcsv][aoei]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^Mi[sm][eoa]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bnfLink(id,label) if not id:match( '^c?b?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz]$' ) then return false end if not id:match( '^cb.+$' ) then --add cb prefix if it has been removed id = 'cb'..id end return '[https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' '..(label or 'France')..'] [https://data.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' (data)]' end
function p.botanistV(id) return mw.ustring.match( id, "^[%u%l%d%. '-]+$" ) --not easily/meaningfully implementable in Lua's regex since "(this)?" is not allowed, better than nothing --id = id:gsub(' +', '%%20') end
function p.bpnV(id) --P651's format regex: \d{6,8} (e.g. 00123456) return id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --original format regex, changed 8/2019 to or id:match( '^0?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --allow 1-2 leading 0s, allowed by the website or id:match( '^0?0?%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.ccgV(id) return id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*%.%d+$' ) end
function p.dbiV(id) local part1, part2; if id:find ('_res', 1, true) then part1, part2 = id:match ('([^_]+)(_res.+)'); -- split at constant '_res'; part 2 nil when no constant '_res' else part1 = id; -- part2 not in target end if part1:find ('[^%-%l]') then -- if <part1> has anything but lowercase letters and hyphens return false; -- invalid so return false else -- here when <part1> has only lowercase letters and hyphens if part1:match ('^%-') or part1:match ('%-$') then -- first and last characters in <part1> must be lowercase letters return false; -- invalid so return false end end if part2 then if not part2:match ('^_res%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return false; -- invalid so return false end end return id end
function p.dblpV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d?%/%d+-?[%d]*[%a]*-?[%d]*$' ) or id:match( '^[%a]+%/[%w]*-?[%d]*$' ) end
function p.gndV(id) return id:match( '^1[012]?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^[47]%d%d%d%d%d%d%-%d$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%-[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^3%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) end
--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end

require('strict') local p = {}
--[[==========================================================================]] --[[ Property formatting functions ]] --[[==========================================================================]]
function p.adbV(id) --P1907's format regex: [a-z][-a-z]+-([1-3]\d|[1-9])\d{0,3} (e.g. barton-sir-edmund-toby-71) return id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-3]%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-9]%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.admiraltyV(id) --P3562's format regex: [A-Q]\d{4}(\.\d+)? (e.g. D1204.1) return id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d$') or id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d%.%d+$') end
function p.awrV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) end
function p.bibsysV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bneV(id) --P950's format regex: (XX|FF|a)\d{4,7}|(bima|bimo|bica|bis[eo]|bivi|Mise|Mimo|Mima)\d{10} (e.g. XX1234567) return id:match( '^[XF][XF]%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^a%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^bi[mcsv][aoei]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^Mi[sm][eoa]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bnfLink(id,label) if not id:match( '^c?b?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz]$' ) then return false end if not id:match( '^cb.+$' ) then --add cb prefix if it has been removed id = 'cb'..id end return '[https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' '..(label or 'France')..'] [https://data.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' (data)]' end
function p.botanistV(id) return mw.ustring.match( id, "^[%u%l%d%. '-]+$" ) --not easily/meaningfully implementable in Lua's regex since "(this)?" is not allowed, better than nothing --id = id:gsub(' +', '%%20') end
function p.bpnV(id) --P651's format regex: \d{6,8} (e.g. 00123456) return id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --original format regex, changed 8/2019 to or id:match( '^0?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --allow 1-2 leading 0s, allowed by the website or id:match( '^0?0?%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.ccgV(id) return id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*%.%d+$' ) end
function p.dbiV(id) local part1, part2; if id:find ('_res', 1, true) then part1, part2 = id:match ('([^_]+)(_res.+)'); -- split at constant '_res'; part 2 nil when no constant '_res' else part1 = id; -- part2 not in target end if part1:find ('[^%-%l]') then -- if <part1> has anything but lowercase letters and hyphens return false; -- invalid so return false else -- here when <part1> has only lowercase letters and hyphens if part1:match ('^%-') or part1:match ('%-$') then -- first and last characters in <part1> must be lowercase letters return false; -- invalid so return false end end if part2 then if not part2:match ('^_res%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return false; -- invalid so return false end end return id end
function p.dblpV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d?%/%d+-?[%d]*[%a]*-?[%d]*$' ) or id:match( '^[%a]+%/[%w]*-?[%d]*$' ) end
function p.gndV(id) return id:match( '^1[012]?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^[47]%d%d%d%d%d%d%-%d$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%-[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^3%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) end
--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end

--[[==========================================================================]] --[[ Property formatting functions ]] --[[==========================================================================]]
function p.adbV(id) --P1907's format regex: [a-z][-a-z]+-([1-3]\d|[1-9])\d{0,3} (e.g. barton-sir-edmund-toby-71) return id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-3]%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-9]%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.admiraltyV(id) --P3562's format regex: [A-Q]\d{4}(\.\d+)? (e.g. D1204.1) return id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d$') or id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d%.%d+$') end
function p.awrV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) end
function p.bibsysV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bneV(id) --P950's format regex: (XX|FF|a)\d{4,7}|(bima|bimo|bica|bis[eo]|bivi|Mise|Mimo|Mima)\d{10} (e.g. XX1234567) return id:match( '^[XF][XF]%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^a%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^bi[mcsv][aoei]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^Mi[sm][eoa]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bnfLink(id,label) if not id:match( '^c?b?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz]$' ) then return false end if not id:match( '^cb.+$' ) then --add cb prefix if it has been removed id = 'cb'..id end return '[https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' '..(label or 'France')..'] [https://data.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' (data)]' end
function p.botanistV(id) return mw.ustring.match( id, "^[%u%l%d%. '-]+$" ) --not easily/meaningfully implementable in Lua's regex since "(this)?" is not allowed, better than nothing --id = id:gsub(' +', '%%20') end
function p.bpnV(id) --P651's format regex: \d{6,8} (e.g. 00123456) return id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --original format regex, changed 8/2019 to or id:match( '^0?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --allow 1-2 leading 0s, allowed by the website or id:match( '^0?0?%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.ccgV(id) return id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*%.%d+$' ) end
function p.dbiV(id) local part1, part2; if id:find ('_res', 1, true) then part1, part2 = id:match ('([^_]+)(_res.+)'); -- split at constant '_res'; part 2 nil when no constant '_res' else part1 = id; -- part2 not in target end if part1:find ('[^%-%l]') then -- if <part1> has anything but lowercase letters and hyphens return false; -- invalid so return false else -- here when <part1> has only lowercase letters and hyphens if part1:match ('^%-') or part1:match ('%-$') then -- first and last characters in <part1> must be lowercase letters return false; -- invalid so return false end end if part2 then if not part2:match ('^_res%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return false; -- invalid so return false end end return id end
function p.dblpV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d?%/%d+-?[%d]*[%a]*-?[%d]*$' ) or id:match( '^[%a]+%/[%w]*-?[%d]*$' ) end
function p.gndV(id) return id:match( '^1[012]?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^[47]%d%d%d%d%d%d%-%d$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%-[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^3%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) end
--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end
p.config = config
-- Legitimate aliases to p.conf, for convenience -- Format: { 'alias', 'parameter name in p.conf' } p.aliases = { { 'DNB', 'GND' }, --Deutsche Nationalbibliothek -> Gemeinsame Normdatei { 'MusicBrainz', 'MBA' }, { 'MusicBrainz artist', 'MBA' }, { 'MusicBrainz label', 'MBL' }, { 'MusicBrainz release group', 'MBRG' }, { 'MusicBrainz work', 'MBW' }, { 'SBN', 'ICCU' }, --SBN alias to be deprecated at a later stage { 'TDVIA', 'TDVİA' }, --alias name without diacritics { 'tdvia', 'TDVİA' }, --lowercase variant without diacritics }
-- Deprecated aliases to p.conf; tracked in [[Category:Articles with deprecated authority control identifiers]] -- Format: { 'deprecated parameter name', 'replacement parameter name in p.conf' } p.deprecated = { { 'GKD', 'GND' }, { 'PND', 'GND' }, { 'RLS', 'RSL' }, { 'SWD', 'GND' }, { 'NARA-organization', 'NARA' }, { 'NARA-person', 'NARA' }, }
p.sectionOrder = { 'General', -- 1 'National libraries', -- 2 'Art galleries and museums', -- 3 'Art research institutes', -- 4 'Biographical dictionaries', -- 5 'Scientific databases', -- 6 'Lighthouse identifiers', -- 7 'Other' -- 8 } return p

--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end

require('strict') local p = {}
--[[==========================================================================]] --[[ Property formatting functions ]] --[[==========================================================================]]
function p.adbV(id) --P1907's format regex: [a-z][-a-z]+-([1-3]\d|[1-9])\d{0,3} (e.g. barton-sir-edmund-toby-71) return id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-3]%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[a-z][-a-z]+-[1-9]%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.admiraltyV(id) --P3562's format regex: [A-Q]\d{4}(\.\d+)? (e.g. D1204.1) return id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d$') or id:match('^[A-Q]%d%d%d%d%.%d+$') end
function p.awrV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]%d%d%d%d%d[a-z]$' ) end
function p.bibsysV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bneV(id) --P950's format regex: (XX|FF|a)\d{4,7}|(bima|bimo|bica|bis[eo]|bivi|Mise|Mimo|Mima)\d{10} (e.g. XX1234567) return id:match( '^[XF][XF]%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^a%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^bi[mcsv][aoei]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^Mi[sm][eoa]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.bnfLink(id,label) if not id:match( '^c?b?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9bcdfghjkmnpqrstvwxz]$' ) then return false end if not id:match( '^cb.+$' ) then --add cb prefix if it has been removed id = 'cb'..id end return '[https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' '..(label or 'France')..'] [https://data.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/'..id..' (data)]' end
function p.botanistV(id) return mw.ustring.match( id, "^[%u%l%d%. '-]+$" ) --not easily/meaningfully implementable in Lua's regex since "(this)?" is not allowed, better than nothing --id = id:gsub(' +', '%%20') end
function p.bpnV(id) --P651's format regex: \d{6,8} (e.g. 00123456) return id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --original format regex, changed 8/2019 to or id:match( '^0?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) --allow 1-2 leading 0s, allowed by the website or id:match( '^0?0?%d%d%d%d%d%d$' ) end
function p.ccgV(id) return id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[NAIP]?[1-9]%d*%.%d+$' ) end
function p.dbiV(id) local part1, part2; if id:find ('_res', 1, true) then part1, part2 = id:match ('([^_]+)(_res.+)'); -- split at constant '_res'; part 2 nil when no constant '_res' else part1 = id; -- part2 not in target end if part1:find ('[^%-%l]') then -- if <part1> has anything but lowercase letters and hyphens return false; -- invalid so return false else -- here when <part1> has only lowercase letters and hyphens if part1:match ('^%-') or part1:match ('%-$') then -- first and last characters in <part1> must be lowercase letters return false; -- invalid so return false end end if part2 then if not part2:match ('^_res%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return false; -- invalid so return false end end return id end
function p.dblpV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d?%/%d+-?[%d]*[%a]*-?[%d]*$' ) or id:match( '^[%a]+%/[%w]*-?[%d]*$' ) end
function p.gndV(id) return id:match( '^1[012]?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^[47]%d%d%d%d%d%d%-%d$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%-[0-9X]$' ) or id:match( '^3%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[0-9X]$' ) end
--Validate ISNI (and ORCID) and retuns it as a 16 characters string or returns false if it's invalid --See http://support.orcid.org/knowledgebase/articles/116780-structure-of-the-orcid-identifier function p.validateIsni(id) --P213 (ISNI) format regex: [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{4} [0-9]{3}[0-9X] (e.g. 0000-0000-6653-4145) --P496 (ORCID) format regex: 0000-000(1-[5-9]|2-[0-9]|3-[0-4])\d{3}-\d{3}[\dX] (e.g. 0000-0002-7398-5483) id = id:gsub( '[ %-]', '' ):upper() if not id:match( '^%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) then return false end local total = 0 for i = 1, 15 do local digit = id:byte( i ) - 48 --Get integer value total = (total + digit) * 2 end local remainder = total % 11 local result = (12 - remainder) % 11 local checkdigit if result == 10 then checkdigit = 'X' else checkdigit=tostring( result ) end if checkdigit ~= string.char( id:byte( 16 ) ) then return false end return id end
function p.lccnV(id) local function splitLccn(id) --P244's format regex: (n|nb|nr|no|ns|sh)([4-9][0-9]|00|20[0-1][0-9])[0-9]{6} (e.g. n78039510) if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) then id = id:gsub( '^(%l+)(%d+)(%d%d%d%d%d%d)$', '%1/%2/%3' ) end if id:match( '^%l%l?%l?/%d%d%d?%d?/%d+$' ) then return mw.text.split( id, '/' ) end return false end local function append(str, c, length) while str:len() < length do str = c..str end return str end local parts = splitLccn(id) --e.g. n78039510 if not parts then return false end local lccnType = parts[1] ~= 'sh' and 'names' or 'subjects' return lccnType .. '/' .. parts[1] .. parts[2] .. append( parts[3], '0', 6 ) end
function p.ndlV(id) return id:match( '^a1%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) or id:match( '^s?%d?%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d' ) end
function p.nlkV(id) return id:match( '^KAB%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KAC%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^KSH%d%d%d%d%a?%d%d%d%d%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.nlpV(id) return id:match( '^9810%d+$' ) or id:match( '^A%d%d%d%d%d%d%d[%dX]$' ) end
function p.orcidV(id) id = p.validateIsni(id) if not id then return false end return id:sub( 1, 4 )..'-'..id:sub( 5, 8 )..'-'..id:sub( 9, 12 )..'-'..id:sub( 13, 16 ) end
function p.ridV(id) return id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-19%d%d$' ) or id:match( '^[A-Z][A-Z]?[A-Z]?%-%d%d%d%d%-20%d%d$' ) end
function p.rismV(id) return id:match( '^pe[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^ks[1-9]%d*$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d*$' ) end
function p.tlsV(id) id = id:gsub(' +', '_') local idlen = mw.ustring.len(id) if idlen < 4 or idlen > 90 then return false end local regex = '^%u'..string.rep("[%w_',%.%-%(%)%*%/–&]", idlen - 1)..'$' if not mw.ustring.match(id,regex ) then return false end return id end
function p.uscgLink(id) local id2 = id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-7]%-%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%.%d*[1-9]$' ) if id2 then return '[https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/pdf/lightlists/LightList%20V'..mw.ustring.sub(id2,1,1)..'.pdf '..id2..']' else return false end end
function p.vcbaV(id) return id:match( '^%d%d%d\/[1-9]%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ):gsub('\/', '_') end
function p.viafV(id) return id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?$' ) or id:match( '^[1-9]%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d?%d?%d?$' ) end
function p.worldcatidV(id) if not id:match( '^viaf%-%d+$' ) and not id:match( '^lccn%-n[a-z]?[0-9%-]+$' ) and not id:match( '^n[cps]%-.+$' ) then return false end return mw.uri.encode(id, 'PATH') end
function p.zbmathV(id) local ps = {'%l[%l%-]*', '%.%l[%l%-]*', '%.%d*'} return id:match( '^'..ps[1]..'$' ) -- prefix with no capture options or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..'$' ) -- prefix with first capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix with second capture option or id:match( '^'..ps[1]..ps[2]..ps[3]..'$' ) -- prefix and both capture options end
